WITH driver_stats AS (
  SELECT
    r.driverId,
    SUM(r.points) as total_points,
    AVG(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) as avg_laps
  FROM results r
  WHERE r.grid > 12 AND r.laps IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.driverId
)
SELECT
  AVG(total_points) as avg_points_total,
  AVG(avg_laps) as avg_of_avg_laps
FROM driver_stats;
